tools.description: List text frames with summary-level information (including orientation and threaded-frame links nextFrameUUID/previousFrameUUID). Supports reading-order sort, pagination, and a lightweight contents-only mode. layer_name includes text inside groups and sublayers of that layer.

sort.description: Sort order. "reading-order" sorts by artboardIndex asc → y asc → x asc (rows within ~5pt tolerance are treated as the same line). On artboards where most frames are vertical text, columns are read right → left, then top → bottom.

contents_only.description: When true, return only uuid, contents, and artboardIndex (no position/font/style info). Useful for text proofreading.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (for pagination). Applied after sort.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (for pagination). Applied after sort.

tools.title: Find Objects
tools.description: Search for objects by specified criteria

fill_color.description: Search paths and compound paths (matched by their inner paths) by fill color. Tolerance defaults to 5 per channel (0-255 for RGB, 0-100 for CMYK). Set tolerance: 0 for exact match.

stroke_color.description: Search paths and compound paths (matched by their inner paths) by stroke color. Tolerance defaults to 5 per channel (0-255 for RGB, 0-100 for CMYK). Set tolerance: 0 for exact match.

tools.name: check_contrast
tools.title: Check Contrast
tools.description: Check WCAG color contrast ratios. Manual mode: provide color1 and color2. Auto mode (auto_detect: true): find visible foreground/background pairs by bounding-box overlap (stacking order, opacity and clipping are not considered; gradient/pattern/image backgrounds are reported as unevaluated). Non-RGB colors are converted without ICC profiles, so their ratio is approximate and WCAG pass/fail is null. GrayColor uses ink-quantity interpretation (0=white, 100=black), which differs from the API reference.

auto_detect.description: Auto-detect overlapping foreground/background color pairs in the document. Do not combine with color1/color2.

tools.name: extract_design_tokens
tools.title: Extract Design Tokens
tools.description: Extract colors, typography, and spacing from the document as design tokens in CSS custom properties, JSON, or Tailwind format. Optionally writes the result to output_path (never overwrites an existing file unless overwrite: true).

output_path.description: Absolute file path to save the output (e.g. "/path/to/tokens.json"). If omitted, returns text only.

overwrite.description: Replace output_path if it already exists. Default false: an existing file is left untouched and an error is returned.

tools.name: export
tools.title: Export
tools.description: Export objects, groups, artboards, or selection. Use target "artboard:all" to batch-export every artboard in one call. For single PNG/JPG exports, the exported image is returned as base64 in the response — you can view it directly without reading the file from disk ("artboard:all" returns file paths only; images larger than ~3.75MB are not inlined). An explicit output_path that already exists is not overwritten unless overwrite is true.

target.description: UUID, "artboard:<index>", "artboard:all" (batch-export every artboard; filenames get "_<n>-<artboardName>" suffixes), or "selection". UUID and "selection" export only those objects, cropped to their visible bounds (they are duplicated into a temporary document; the clipboard and current selection are left untouched).

output_path.description: Absolute output file path (SVG file names must be ASCII). The extension must match format (.svg/.png/.jpg); it is added if omitted. If omitted, auto-generates a non-conflicting name in the same directory as the document (or ~/Desktop for unsaved documents)

overwrite.description: Replace existing files at output_path (including "artboard:all" per-artboard files). Default false: returns an error listing the existing files

scale.description: Scale factor for PNG/JPG (dpi × scale must be <= 2400)

encoding.description: SVG document encoding (default: "utf8"). "ascii" is the Illustrator default and writes every non-ASCII character as a numeric character reference, declaring iso-8859-1.

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.title: Export PDF
tools.description: Export print-ready PDF. Japanese trim marks (marks_style "japanese" + trim_marks) are drawn temporarily on the document and removed after export; they are only supported for single-artboard documents (multi-artboard documents return an error). When a preset is given, trim mark settings you do not specify are kept from the preset. An explicit output_path that already exists is not overwritten unless overwrite is true. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) only when generating Japanese trim marks. The exported PDF should be verified by a human before final submission.

output_path.description: Absolute output file path ending in .pdf (.pdf is added if omitted). If omitted, auto-generates a non-conflicting name in the same directory as the document (or ~/Desktop for unsaved documents)

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at output_path. Default false: returns an error with existing_files and exports nothing

preset.description: PDF preset name (e.g. "[PDF/X-4:2008]"). Must exist in Illustrator's PDF presets, otherwise an error listing available presets is returned.

trim_marks.description: Add trim marks. If omitted with a preset, the preset's setting is kept.

marks_style.description: Trim mark style (japanese or roman). Japanese + trim_marks requires a single-artboard document.

downsample.description: Downsample all images (shorthand: color 300dpi, grayscale 300dpi, monochrome 1200dpi)

color_downsample_dpi.description: Color image downsample target DPI (overrides downsample)

grayscale_downsample_dpi.description: Grayscale image downsample target DPI (overrides downsample)

monochrome_downsample_dpi.description: Monochrome image downsample target DPI (overrides downsample)

output_intent_profile.description: Output intent ICC profile name (e.g. "Japan Color 2001 Coated"). Version-dependent feature.

tools.name: get_overprint_info
tools.title: Get Overprint Info
tools.description: Get overprint settings of paths (incl. compound paths), text (per character) and raster images, each with a heuristic label (K100 / rich black / spot / likely accidental) inferred from colors only. The result includes the scan scope; placed files, symbols and meshes are not inspected.

tools.name: get_separation_info
tools.title: Get Separation Info
tools.description: Get color separation info: process and spot plates actually used by the artwork (paths, gradients, text, rasters) with usage counts, inks with no detected usage, global process colors, and Illustrator's document ink list. The result includes the scan scope; placed files, patterns and symbols are not inspected.

tools.name: preflight_check
tools.title: Preflight Check
tools.description: Run pre-press quality checks (RGB in CMYK incl. gradient stops, text colors and embedded images; broken links; low resolution; fonts; white overprint on paths and text; transparency; spot colors). `coverage` reports per check whether it was fully checked, partial (sampled or uninspectable contents such as symbols, linked files, live effects under x1a) or skipped — a check marked partial/skipped is not a clean pass. Results are capped at 20 per category; the rest are summarized in one entry with counts and UUIDs (`categoryCounts` has totals). Not exhaustive — does not replace a human final review. GrayColor uses ink-quantity interpretation (0=white/no ink, 100=black/full ink), which differs from the API reference.

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

target_pdf_profile.description: Target PDF/X profile for compliance checks. x1a: no transparency/RGB, fonts must be embeddable (installed). x4: allows transparency, recommends ICC profile.

tools.name: check_text_consistency
tools.title: Check Text Consistency
tools.description: Analyze text frames for dummy/placeholder text and known notation variation patterns (katakana long vowel, fullwidth/halfwidth, wave dash/tilde). Returns all text contents for LLM-driven deeper analysis of inconsistencies, typos, and version mismatches. Note: AI analysis may miss errors and does not replace a human text review.

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. tools.description: Set the session-level workflow and default coordinate system. Call this after confirming the user's intent (web, print, or video). Once set, all tools that omit coordinate_system will use the session default. Use clear: true to reset to auto-detection from document (CMYK/print → document coords, RGB/web → artboard-web).

workflow.description: The workflow type. Determines the default coordinate system.

coordinate_system.description: Explicit coordinate system override. If provided with workflow, overrides the workflow-derived default.

clear.description: Reset session to default behavior (auto-detect from document).

tools.name: set_illustrator_version
tools.title: Set Illustrator Version
tools.description: Set which Illustrator version to target when multiple versions are installed. Specify a version year (e.g. "2024", "2025"). If Illustrator is already running, connects to the running instance regardless of version. If not running, launches the specified version. Use clear: true to reset to default behavior (connect to any running Illustrator).

clear.description: Reset to default behavior (connect to any running Illustrator).

tools.name: create_text_frame
tools.title: Create Text Frame
tools.description: Create a text frame. Positioning differs by kind: for point text (x, y) is the text ANCHOR — y is the BASELINE of the first line (glyphs extend above it), and x is the left edge, center, or right edge depending on justification (so right-aligned text only needs justification: "right" with x at the right edge). For area text (x, y) is the top-left of the text area. verified.bounds always reports the resulting bounding box (top-left, width, height) — that box is what modify_object position moves. If font_name is not found, nothing is created and an error with font_candidates is returned. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

x.description: X coordinate. Point text: anchor x (left/center/right edge per justification). Area text: left edge.

y.description: Y coordinate. Point text: BASELINE of the first line, not the top of the glyphs. Area text: top edge.

contents.description: Text contents. Use \n for line breaks (automatically converted to CR for Illustrator).

font_name.description: Exact font name as listed by list_fonts (the "name" field, e.g. "HelveticaNeue-Bold", "ArialMT"). Not a partial match: if not found, nothing is created and an error with font_candidates is returned.

tracking.description: Letter spacing (tracking) in 1/1000 em, applied to the whole frame. 0 = none, positive = looser, negative = tighter. Same units and range as the tracking field in Illustrator's Character panel.

leading.description: Line spacing (leading) in pt, applied to the whole frame. Omit for auto leading (auto leading can be large in Japanese-default environments, e.g. 175%; set this for tight multi-line Latin text).

justification.description: Paragraph alignment for all paragraphs: left | center | right, or justified with the last line left/center/right (justify_left, justify_center, justify_right) or all lines forced (justify_all). Justified values only have an effect on area text.

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.title: Create Path
tools.description: Create a custom path. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: modify_object
tools.title: Modify Object
tools.description: Modify properties of an existing object. fill/stroke on a group or compound path are applied to every path and text frame inside it (like Illustrator's UI; clipping paths and guides are skipped) and the result reports how many were changed (painted) and the colors they actually have (verified.descendantFills). success is false if any of them could not be painted. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

fill.description: Fill color. For text frames this is the character color; for groups/compound paths it is applied to all paths and text inside

stroke.description: Stroke settings. For groups/compound paths it is applied to all paths and text inside

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees. Default mode is "delta" (additive). Use rotation_mode: "absolute" for target angle.

rotation_mode.description: delta = add to current rotation, absolute = set to exact angle

hidden.description: Hide (true) or show (false) the object without deleting it

locked.description: Lock (true) or unlock (false) the object. Unlock is applied before other changes, lock after them

font_name.description: Exact font name for text frames, as listed by list_fonts (the 'name' field, e.g. PostScript name 'HelveticaNeue-Bold'). If not found, nothing is modified and an error with font_candidates is returned

tracking.description: Letter spacing (tracking) in 1/1000 em, for text frames. 0 = none, positive = looser, negative = tighter. Same units and range as Illustrator's Character panel.

justification.description: Paragraph alignment for text frames, applied to all paragraphs

leading.description: Line spacing (leading) in pt for text frames, or "auto" for auto leading. Omit to leave unchanged

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: convert_to_outlines
tools.title: Convert to Outlines
tools.description: Convert text to outlines (irreversible except via undo). Text frames that cannot be converted (e.g. locked) are left as-is and listed in "failed" with the reason; success is false if any failed. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

target.description: Target: "selection" (selected), "all" (all text), or a top-level layer name (includes text inside groups and sublayers; if several layers share the name, the topmost one is used and a warning is returned)

tools.name: place_image
tools.title: Place Image
tools.description: Place a raster or PDF image file (PNG, JPG, TIFF, PSD, PDF, etc.) into the document as a linked or embedded image. SVG is NOT supported here because PlacedItems produces a non-editable linked artwork — use import_svg_as_editable instead to bring SVG content in as editable paths/text. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the image file

embed.description: Embed the image instead of linking (default: false)

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: import_svg_as_editable
tools.title: Import SVG as Editable
tools.description: Import an SVG file into the active document as editable Illustrator paths/text/groups (NOT as a linked image). Internally opens the SVG as a temporary document, duplicates its contents into the target document, then closes the source. Use this instead of place_image for SVG. Colors are NOT converted: importing into a CMYK document keeps the SVG's RGB colors, and the result then includes a warning with the count (fix with replace_color). Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution. Font caveat: Illustrator does not fall back per glyph across a font-family list. If the FIRST family in the list is installed but lacks a glyph, that character is dropped silently and the import still reports success. Specify a single font-family per text element, and pick one that actually contains the glyphs you use (symbols such as U+2713 are the common failure case). An uninstalled family is substituted by Illustrator and is NOT affected by this.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .svg or .svgz file

x.description: X position of the imported content (top-left of bounding box). Ignored when fit_to_artboard is true.

y.description: Y position of the imported content (top-left of bounding box). Ignored when fit_to_artboard is true.

layer_name.description: Target layer name in the active document. Created if missing.

group.description: Wrap imported items in a single GroupItem (default: true). Set false to keep items flat in the target layer.

fit_to_artboard.description: Scale and center the imported content to fit the active artboard (default: false). Works in both coordinate systems.

padding.description: Padding in points from the artboard edges when fit_to_artboard is true.

name.description: Name to assign to the root group (only when group=true and multiple items are imported).

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: resize_for_variation
tools.title: Resize for Variation
tools.description: Create size variations from a source artboard. Duplicates all objects and scales/repositions them proportionally to fit target sizes. New artboards are placed to the right of all existing artboards; copies get new UUIDs. Limitations: no text reflow, effects/strokes scale with objects but may need manual adjustment, proportional placement only (not smart layout).

source_artboard_index.description: Source artboard index to duplicate from (0-based)

scale_mode.description: How to scale objects: proportional (fit within, maintain aspect), fit_width, or fit_height

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: align_objects
tools.title: Align Objects
tools.description: Align and/or distribute multiple objects by their UUIDs. If any UUID is not found, nothing is moved and the missing UUIDs are returned in notFound.

reference.description: Align relative to selection bounding box or active artboard

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: replace_color
tools.title: Replace Color
tools.description: Find and replace fill/stroke colors of paths and text characters across the document or within a specific layer. replacedCount counts replaced path fills/strokes; textFramesChanged counts text frames in which at least one character color was replaced (text strokes with weight 0 are ignored). Every replacement is read back; matches that could not be replaced (e.g. locked) are listed in failed and make success false. A layer scope includes groups and sublayers inside it. from_color must be cmyk or rgb and matches only objects whose current color is stored in that same color type (check with get_colors) — an RGB from_color does not match CMYK-colored objects. to_color can be any type, e.g. replace an RGB color with a CMYK one. Spot, gray, gradient and pattern colors are never matched.

from_color.description: Color to find (required). cmyk or rgb, in the same color type the objects currently use

to_color.description: Replacement color (required). Any type; need not match from_color's type

tolerance.description: Color matching tolerance per channel (0 = exact match, 100 = match any)

scope.description: Layer name to limit replacement scope (default: entire document)

tools.name: manage_layers
tools.title: Manage Layers
tools.description: Add, rename, show/hide, lock/unlock, reorder, or delete top-level layers by name. If several layers share a name, rename/show/hide/lock/unlock/reorder act on the topmost one with a warning, and delete is refused.

layer_name.description: Target layer name (for add: new layer name)

above.description: For add: create above this layer name

tools.name: place_color_chips
tools.title: Place Color Chips
tools.description: Extract all unique colors used in the document (path fills/strokes including inside groups and compound paths, text colors, gradient stop colors; spot colors per tint) and place color chip swatches with labels outside the artboard. Pattern fills cannot be shown as chips and are counted in skippedColors. Items already on the chip layer are ignored.

position.description: Place chips to the right or below the artboard

include_info.description: Include color value labels next to chips

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: place_style_guide
tools.title: Place Style Guide
tools.description: Place a visual style guide next to the artboard: color chips (path, text and gradient stop colors), font samples, and legends of recurring spacings, artboard margins and guide gaps. Everything goes on a NON-PRINTING layer (created with Print off; if layer_name already exists its print setting is kept and a warning is returned). By default nothing is drawn on the artboard itself; set annotate_artboard=true to also draw semi-transparent measurement bars and numbers ON the artboard (same non-printing layer, but visible on screen and possibly in screen/image exports).

position.description: Place style guide to the right or below the artboard

layer_name.description: Layer name for the style guide

annotate_artboard.description: Also draw measurement bars and numbers ON the artboard for spacings, margins and guide gaps (default: false = legends only, placed outside the artboard)

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: create_crop_marks
tools.title: Create Crop Marks (トンボ)
tools.description: Create crop marks (トンボ / trim marks) on the active artboard or selected objects. By default, creates marks for the artboard and expands the artboard to include all marks; the original (trim) rectangle is returned as original_artboard_rect. With use_selection=true, creates marks for the currently selected object(s) without modifying the artboard. Automatically selects Japanese-style (日本式) or Western-style crop marks based on locale. The Illustrator crop mark style preference, selection and active artboard are restored afterwards. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

style.description: Crop mark style. "japanese" = double-line marks with 3mm bleed indication (日本式トンボ). "western" = single-line marks (西洋式トンボ). "auto" = detect from locale parameter or Illustrator locale.

locale.description: User locale (e.g. "ja", "ja-JP", "en-US", "de-DE"). Used to auto-detect crop mark style when style is "auto". Japanese locales (ja*) → Japanese marks, others → Western marks. If omitted, falls back to Illustrator's own locale setting.

use_selection.description: If true, create crop marks for the currently selected object(s) instead of the artboard. The artboard will NOT be modified. If false (default), creates marks for the artboard and expands it to fit.

artboard_index.description: Target artboard index (0-based). Defaults to the currently active artboard. Ignored when use_selection is true.

tools.name: create_document
tools.title: Create Document
tools.description: Create a new Illustrator document. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

width.description: Document width in points (default: A4 width 595.28pt)

height.description: Document height in points (default: A4 height 841.89pt)

tools.name: close_document
tools.title: Close Document
tools.description: Close the active Illustrator document. If the document has unsaved changes and save is omitted, the document is NOT closed and an error is returned — pass save: true to save, or save: false to explicitly discard the changes. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

save.description: true = save then close; false = close and DISCARD unsaved changes. Omit to close only when there are no unsaved changes

tools.name: save_document
tools.title: Save Document
tools.description: Save the active Illustrator document. save_as refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite is true. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

mode.description: save = overwrite, save_as = save to new path

path.description: Absolute file path for save_as mode. If omitted, auto-generates a new non-conflicting name (<name>_2.ai, ...) in the same directory as the document (or ~/Desktop for unsaved documents)

overwrite.description: save_as only: allow replacing an existing file at path (default: false = error if the file exists)

tools.name: open_document
tools.title: Open Document
tools.description: Open an Illustrator document from a file path. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

path.description: Absolute file path to open (.ai, .eps, .pdf, .svg, etc.)

color_space.description: Force color space conversion on open. Omit to keep original.

tools.name: group_objects
tools.title: Group Objects
tools.description: Group multiple objects into a single group. The first UUID in the array becomes the bottommost item, the last becomes the topmost. If any UUID is not found, nothing is grouped and the missing UUIDs are returned in notFound. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

uuids.description: UUIDs of objects to group. Order matters: first=bottom, last=top in layer panel.

clipped.description: Create as clipping group. The last UUID becomes the clip path (topmost). Example: [content-uuid, mask-uuid] — mask-uuid clips content-uuid.

tools.name: ungroup_objects
tools.title: Ungroup Objects
tools.description: Ungroup a group, releasing its children to the parent layer. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

uuid.description: UUID of the group to ungroup

tools.name: duplicate_objects
tools.title: Duplicate Objects
tools.description: Duplicate one or more objects, optionally offsetting the copies. Copies (and their group/compound-path children) get new UUIDs; notes/memos are kept (objects whose note cannot be rewritten keep the source UUID and are listed in warnings). Missing UUIDs are listed in notFound and per-item failures in failed (success is then false, but copies that were made are still returned). Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

y.description: Y offset from original. Positive = down in artboard-web, up in document coordinates.

target_layer.description: Top-level layer name to place duplicates in. If several layers share the name, the topmost one is used and a warning is returned

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.title: List Fonts
tools.description: List fonts available in Illustrator. Does not require an open document.

filter.description: Filter by family or name (case-insensitive partial match)

tools.name: manage_artboards
tools.title: Manage Artboards
tools.description: Add, remove, resize, rename, fit, or rearrange artboards. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

index.description: Target artboard index (0-based). Required for remove/resize/rename/fit_to_art. Note: the last remaining artboard cannot be removed.

rect.description: Position and size for add/resize (document coordinates)

rows_or_cols.description: Number of rows or columns for rearrange

tools.name: set_z_order
tools.title: Set Z-Order
tools.description: Change the stacking order of an object. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

tools.name: move_to_layer
tools.title: Move to Layer
tools.description: Move one or more objects to a different layer. Objects that are found are moved; missing UUIDs are listed in notFound and per-object failures in errors (success is false if either is non-empty). Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

target_layer.description: Target top-level layer name. If several layers share the name, the topmost one is used and a warning is returned

position.description: beginning = front of layer, end = back of layer

tools.name: delete_objects
tools.title: Delete Objects
tools.description: Delete one or more objects by UUID (get UUIDs from find_objects / get_layers / get_selection). Locked objects are skipped unless force_unlock is true. success is false if any UUID was not found or could not be deleted (see notFound / errors). The undo tool may revert it, but undo steps are Illustrator history steps, not tied to MCP calls. To delete a whole layer use manage_layers instead. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

force_unlock.description: Unlock locked objects before deleting them (default: false = skip locked objects with an error)

tools.name: apply_graphic_style
tools.title: Apply Graphic Style
tools.description: Apply a graphic style to objects. Objects that are found are styled; missing UUIDs are listed in notFound and per-object failures in errors (success is false if either is non-empty). Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

style_name.description: Name of the graphic style to apply

merge.description: true = merge with existing appearance, false = replace

tools.name: list_graphic_styles
tools.title: List Graphic Styles
tools.description: List all graphic styles in the active document.

tools.name: manage_swatches
tools.title: Manage Swatches
tools.description: Add, update, or delete swatches in the active document. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

tools.name: apply_text_style
tools.title: Apply Text Style
tools.description: Apply a character or paragraph style to a text frame. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

clear_overrides.description: Clear existing formatting overrides before applying

tools.name: list_text_styles
tools.title: List Text Styles
tools.description: List all character and paragraph styles in the active document.

tools.name: create_gradient
tools.title: Create Gradient
tools.description: Create a gradient in the document and optionally apply it to objects. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

mid_point.description: Midpoint between this stop and next (13-87)

apply_to_uuids.description: UUIDs of objects to apply this gradient as fill. For groups/compound paths it is applied to every path and text inside (clipping paths and guides are skipped) and checked by reading back; verified then reports descendantFills. UUIDs that cannot be found are listed in notFound, objects that could not be painted in errors; either makes success false (the gradient itself is still created).

angle.description: Gradient angle (for linear). Note: may not take effect due to a long-standing Illustrator bug (since 2008).

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: manage_linked_images
tools.title: Manage Linked Images
tools.description: Relink or embed a placed (linked) image. embed converts PlacedItem to RasterItem — the original UUID becomes invalid and a new UUID for the RasterItem is returned. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo / Redo
tools.description: Undo or redo steps in Illustrator's history. Steps are Illustrator history entries, not MCP tool calls (one tool call may create several steps). Returns count = steps actually performed; if a step fails, the result is an error that still reports how many were performed. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

tools.name: manage_datasets
tools.title: Manage Variables & Datasets
tools.description: List variables/datasets, apply or create datasets, bind variables to objects, import/export variable XML, or generate artboards from CSV. import (XML) replaces ALL existing variables and datasets in the document. import_csv does not create variables or datasets: it copies the objects on artboard 0 (left unchanged as the template) onto one new artboard per CSV row, placed to the right of existing artboards, and sets the text of copied text frames whose name matches a CSV header. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

object_name.description: Object name to bind variable to (for bind_variable)

dataset_name_prefix.description: Prefix for auto-generated dataset names (for import_csv). If omitted, first column value is used.

file_path.description: File path (XML for import/export, CSV for import_csv)

tools.name: place_symbol
tools.title: Place Symbol
tools.description: Place a new symbol instance or replace the symbol definition of an existing instance. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

action.description: place = new instance, replace = swap symbol definition

symbol_name.description: Symbol name to place or new symbol name for replace

x.description: X of the instance top-left (for place action)

y.description: Y of the instance top-left (for place action)

uuid.description: UUID of existing symbol item (for replace action)

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: create_path_text
tools.title: Create Path Text
tools.description: Create a text frame that flows along a path. If font_name is not found, nothing is created and an error with font_candidates is returned. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

path_uuid.description: UUID of the path to place text along

font_name.description: Exact font name as listed by list_fonts (the "name" field, e.g. "ArialMT"). Not a partial match: if not found, nothing is created and an error with font_candidates is returned.

tracking.description: Letter spacing (tracking) in 1/1000 em. 0 = none, positive = looser, negative = tighter. Same units and range as Illustrator's Character panel.

justification.description: Alignment of the text along the path: left (from the path start) | center | right (toward the path end).

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system. Auto-detected from document by default (CMYK/print → document, RGB/web → artboard-web). artboard-web: origin at active artboard top-left, Y-down. document: Illustrator native coords, origin at bottom-left, Y-up. Call get_document_info to check which system is active.

tools.name: select_objects
tools.title: Select Objects
tools.description: Select objects by UUID. Pass an empty array to deselect all. Selected objects can then be manipulated interactively in Illustrator.

uuids.description: Array of object UUIDs to select. Pass empty array [] to deselect all.

tools.name: convert_coordinate
tools.title: Convert Coordinate
tools.description: Convert a point between artboard and document coordinate systems in the active document.
